related.title: IonQ Raman 控制：失諧與散射代理
related.titleEn: IonQ Raman control: detuning and scattering proxy
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付相空間迴圈、閉合殘差與幾何相位待驗清單。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver phase-space loops, closure residuals and unverified geometric-phase requirements. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『IonQ Raman 控制：失諧與散射代理』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付固定窗與等角度兩種實驗設計，並標出不能直接比較的欄位。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'IonQ Raman control: detuning and scattering proxy', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver fixed-window and equal-angle experiment plans, marking incomparable fields.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：單模式驅動的相空間迴圈在δt=2π時閉合；δ為rad/s。閉合本身不保證正確糾纏相位。 使用教學失諧δ/(2π)=20 kHz；以μs求一圈時間，排除其他模式。 以手算或試算表計算名義式1/20e3*1e6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：用exp(iδt)的cos與sin分量驗證終點(1,0)；另列需調整的力幅度以維持幾何相位。

先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：固定單光子驅動時，散射代理Γsc∝1/Δ²；同時Raman耦合亦隨失諧改變，不能只看散射。 使用教學參考Δ0=100 GHz、Γ0=40 s⁻¹，Γsc=Γ0(Δ0/Δ)²；固定觀察窗200 μs。 以手算或試算表計算名義式40*(100/100)**2*200e-6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：核對Γsc單位s⁻¹乘秒得無量綱；若要同旋轉角，另延長門時間並重新積分散射。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: A single-mode driven phase-space loop closes when δt=2π, with δ in rad/s; closure alone does not guarantee the desired entangling phase. Use Teaching detuning δ/(2π)=20 kHz; solve one-loop time in μs with other modes excluded. Evaluate nominal expression 1/20e3*1e6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check endpoint(1,0) using cos and sin of δt; separately list force-amplitude adjustment needed to preserve geometric phase.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: At fixed single-photon drive, scattering proxy Γsc∝1/Δ²; Raman coupling also changes with detuning, so scattering is not the only metric. Use Teaching reference Δ0=100 GHz, Γ0=40 s⁻¹ and Γsc=Γ0(Δ0/Δ)²; observation window is fixed at200 μs. Evaluate nominal expression 40*(100/100)**2*200e-6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check s⁻¹ times seconds is dimensionless; equal-angle operation requires a separate duration adjustment and new scattering integral.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: QuEra Aquila：Rydberg 交互作用的距離六次方
related.titleEn: QuEra Aquila: sixth-power distance scaling of Rydberg interactions
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付相空間迴圈、閉合殘差與幾何相位待驗清單。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。

Outcome: Deliver distance/interaction curves, linearization errors and geometry acceptance.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：單模式驅動的相空間迴圈在δt=2π時閉合；δ為rad/s。閉合本身不保證正確糾纏相位。 使用教學失諧δ/(2π)=20 kHz；以μs求一圈時間，排除其他模式。 以手算或試算表計算名義式1/20e3*1e6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：用exp(iδt)的cos與sin分量驗證終點(1,0)；另列需調整的力幅度以維持幾何相位。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：van der Waals區間V(r)=C6/r⁶；以V(r0)比值寫V(r)=V0(r0/r)⁶，避免混用角頻率與能量。 使用教學V0/h=10 MHz於r0=5 μm；不使用實際原子態的C6規格。 以手算或試算表計算名義式10*(5/5)**6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：確認V×r⁶固定；用微分δV/V≈−6δr/r只估很小擾動，不能拿20%變化直接替代精確式。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: A single-mode driven phase-space loop closes when δt=2π, with δ in rad/s; closure alone does not guarantee the desired entangling phase. Use Teaching detuning δ/(2π)=20 kHz; solve one-loop time in μs with other modes excluded. Evaluate nominal expression 1/20e3*1e6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check endpoint(1,0) using cos and sin of δt; separately list force-amplitude adjustment needed to preserve geometric phase.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: In the van der Waals regime V(r)=C6/r⁶; use V(r)=V0(r0/r)⁶ to keep angular-frequency and energy conventions consistent. Use Teaching V0/h=10 MHz at r0=5 μm; no real atomic-state C6 specification is assumed. Evaluate nominal expression 10*(5/5)**6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check invariant V×r⁶; use δV/V≈−6δr/r only for small perturbations, not as an exact20% change.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
